info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Reminders-v4-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Reminders API provides access to reminders related to utility billing, ensuring customers are informed about upcoming payment deadlines. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of pending and upcoming billing reminders, which can assist in budget planning and timely payments. Typical consumers include utility companies, billing systems, or applications that manage customer finances. By integrating this API, developers can enhance customer engagement and streamline communication regarding billing obligations.

get.description: This operation allows you to fetch the current billing reminders associated with the user's account. It provides important information regarding upcoming payments and due dates to help users manage their billing more effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body provides information required to retrieve billing reminder details. It should include necessary parameters in the JSON format to specify the user's billing reminders to be fetched.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON string expected in the body of the request for getting billing reminder operations.
